name: Signed Dual-Space Spectral Defense
tagline: Per-class signed spectral score on features and logits, fused by Cohen's d, applied only to over-sized (target) classes.
init_recovers: Spectral Signatures only on the over-sized class when w_f=1, w_l=0, signed→absolute.
diff_from_baseline: Three changes vs. spectral_signature: (i) restricts scoring to the inflated/target class only, (ii) keeps only the poison-side projections (signed proj² rather than full proj²), (iii) fuses an on-the-fly logit-PCA score with the feature score by Cohen's d separation — also adds an adaptive poison-side identification with 3 tiebreakers.

name: IPSOD: Iterative Purified Spectral
tagline: Two-pass median-centred spectral signature (purify by removing top 30% then re-fit) plus a per-class MAD confidence z-score.
init_recovers: Spectral Signatures (Tran 2018) when pass-2 returns the same direction as pass-1 and conf weight = 0.
diff_from_baseline: Adds two pieces on top of the spectral_signature baseline: (i) median-centred SVD performed twice with a 30% trim between passes, and (ii) a robust confidence z-score (median + MAD) that is min-max normalised and additively combined per class — neither baseline iterates the SVD or fuses with confidence.

name: Loss-Signed Spectral with Size Amp
tagline: Per-class 1-D k-means on the top spectral projection, sign chosen by per-cluster median NLL, then amplified by (n_c/n_max)¹⁰.
init_recovers: Spectral Signatures up to a sign when amp=1 (only one class).
diff_from_baseline: Compared to spectral_signature, the magnitude (proj²) is replaced by a *signed* score (proj·|proj|) whose sign comes from per-cluster median NLL rather than absolute projection, and the entire score is multiplied by a 10th-power class-size amplifier so non-target classes get ~0 — neither spectral_signature nor activation_clustering sign by loss or amplify by class size.

name: Count-Gated Bi-Prototype Defense
tagline: Spectral-init 2-means per class yielding clean/suspect prototypes; score = gated rank-fusion of affinity, axis projection, distance, label confidence.

key_hyperparams.name: k-means init
key_hyperparams.value: 1-D k-means on top SV of class

init_recovers: Activation-clustering-style scoring in the gated class (gate=1) with no rank fusion (fused=0).
diff_from_baseline: Generalises activation_clustering: spectral-initialised 2-means, scores by a *4-component rank fusion* (affinity, projection, distance, label confidence) and multiplies by a class gate that is ≈1 only for the most anomalous class identified by a hand-crafted score — neither the spectral_signature nor activation_clustering baseline gates by class anomaly or rank-fuses confidence.

name: Median-Spectral × Confidence Coupling
tagline: Spectral signature with geometric-median centring and MAD-normalised projections, coupled multiplicatively with per-sample confidence.
init_recovers: Spectral Signatures (Tran 2018) on the geometric-median centre.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the mean-centred per-class spectral signature with a Weiszfeld geometric-median centre and MAD-scaled projections, multiplies by per-sample max-softmax confidence (high spectral ∧ high confidence ⇒ poison), and 0.3-weights an additional global-PCA score — none of the baselines use geometric median, MAD scaling, or confidence-modulated spectral coupling.
